_comment: C10 (verify:compute-lanes) — the DERIVED enumeration of admission call sites (design §5:
'~30 admission call sites is the M-002 rot pattern ... Design the enumeration to be derived, or it will rot').
The gate scans src/ for spawn()/localInfer()/localStream() and FAILS unless each site is either
(a) in a file that integrates the compute governor (imports it AND calls admit()), or
(b) listed here with a reason. This list is therefore the RESIDUAL LEDGER — every heavy lane NOT
yet routed through the governor lives here, with why. It is a RATCHET: it may shrink (as lanes get
wired) but a new entry needs a reason. Keys are 'src/relative/path.js:line' at the time of writing;
the gate matches by FILE (line is documentation), so a line shift does not silently un-cover a site.
_residuals: BULK count cap = 2 with no aging floor (round-2 review minor #3): two long transcriptions can hold both BULK slots and starve the ~1 GB embed drain even when the GB sum-budget has room. BOUNDED and SELF-RESOLVING — transcriptions are finite; when they finish the BULK count drops and embed resumes; embed is DEFER (re-selects its pending set every cycle, no data loss). NOT a crash path. A BULK aging floor (promote a starved BULK lane to a 3rd slot) was DELIBERATELY NOT added: a 3rd concurrent BULK lane could push memory past the headroom the round-2 RESIDENT+BULK pressure gates just secured, so trading a bounded latency for a possible OOM is the wrong call. Revisit only with per-lane RSS measurement (design §6).

Chat/scheduler LOCAL inference (L11/L12) — see the src/inference/router.js allow entry for the full evidence-based deferral (operator chat is cloud; shared-router deadlock; needs model-load-aware admission).
The channel-daemon second OS process (L13) — an in-process governor cannot gate it; see the src/channels/supervisor.js allow entry. Largest documented hole (design §5).

allow.src/hardware/ollama-daemon.js: Spawns the Ollama DAEMON itself (spawn/spawnServe) — the runtime whose model-loading the governor gates ACCESS to, not a model lane of its own. An ADOPTED daemon cannot be capped at all (returns before OLLAMA_SPAWN_CAPS apply, ollama-daemon.js:416 / design P9,§3.8), which is exactly why the governor holds RESIDENT=1 in-process instead of trusting the daemon.
allow.src/embed/supervisor.js: Spawns the PERSISTENT ONNX embed SERVICE container (:8091) + its dep-probe, ONCE — not per-request compute. The per-cycle embed WORK (L1) IS governed: src/enrich/drainer.js admits a BULK 'embed-drain' ticket around the drain loop. Gating the service-container spawn would hold a ticket forever and wedge everything.
allow.src/transcribe/supervisor.js: Spawns the PERSISTENT faster_whisper SERVICE container (:8093) + its dep-probe/pip-install, ONCE. The per-attachment transcribe WORK (L14) IS governed: src/enrich/transcribe-attachment.js admits a BULK 'transcribe' ticket around the decode. The container spawn is not the concurrency spike; the concurrent DECODE is, and that is ticketed.
allow.src/tts/qwen3-tts-supervisor.js: Spawns the PERSISTENT Qwen3-TTS MLX SERVICE container (:8094), ONCE. RESIDUAL: the TTS RENDER path (L15, tts/voice-render.js renderWithSample) is not yet routed through the governor — a follow-up unit should admit TTS render as BULK. The container spawn itself is a one-time service start, not per-render compute.
allow.src/tts/qwen3-tts-model.js: TTS (L15) model dependency-probe / pip install / model download spawns. RESIDUAL: the TTS render lane is not yet routed through the governor (see qwen3-tts-supervisor above). A follow-up unit should admit TTS render as BULK.
allow.src/channels/supervisor.js: Spawns the CHANNEL DAEMON (packages/channel-daemon), a SEPARATE OS PROCESS with its OWN memory (L13). This is the LARGEST documented residual (design §5): an in-process governor CANNOT gate a second process — a Telegram turn can still collide with a drain. Closing it needs channel turns routed through the vault's /internal/* to admit there, OR OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1 (unavailable on an adopted daemon). Scoped, not hidden.
allow.src/agent/loop-claude-cli.js: Spawns the CLAUDE CLI binary for a chat/agent turn — a CLOUD/subscription process, NOT a local Ollama-resident model, so it loads no on-box model weights and is not the two-model memory crash. (Chat that resolves to a LOCAL model is the separate L11 residual tracked under inference/router.js.)
allow.src/inference/claude-config-dir.js: Spawns the claude CLI to resolve/verify its config dir (cloud/subscription setup), not a local model — no on-box weights loaded.
allow.src/inference/claude-cli-install.js: Spawns a ONE-SHOT external CLI installer/updater — the official Anthropic native installer (curl|bash / PowerShell) or `claude update` — user-initiated from the Engine panel (D-002). An external process with NO on-box model weights, bounded by a timeout, single-flight at the endpoint; not resident compute, so it needs no admit() ticket. Same posture as loop-claude-cli.js / claude-config-dir.js (cloud Claude CLI, no on-box weights).
allow.src/system/keep-awake.js: caffeinate is a power-assertion helper (prevents idle sleep, ~0 CPU/RAM). Not a compute lane.
allow.src/db/snapshot-schedule.js: Spawns the rolling-snapshot WORKER (src/db/snapshot-worker.mjs), a READ-ONLY SQLCipher copy of the vault — no model weights, memory bounded by SQLite page cache, not GB-scale. Same shape as db/integrity.js below (detached, throttled, child.unref()), but DELIBERATELY NOT ticketed rather than filed as a follow-up: a refused admission would mean NO BACKUP TAKEN, and "the vault had no snapshot to restore" is exactly the failure that cost a user their vault on 2026-07-26 (D-110). A durability guarantee must not be subordinate to compute admission. Contention is already bounded at the source: a 1-hour floor between runs, a single-worker O_EXCL lock, and a byte-budget prune — so it cannot stack with itself or run hot during a boot storm.
allow.src/db/integrity.js: Boot vault-integrity SQLCipher scan (L19), detached child, stamp-file throttled, child.unref(). RESIDUAL BULK lane: should admit a BULK ticket so a boot-time integrity scan cannot stack with embed/clustering during the boot storm (design P12).
allow.src/inference/router.js: The inference router's LOCAL path (runLocal/runLocalStream → localInfer/localStream), used by L11 portal chat + L12 scheduler/autonomous turns. DEFERRED with evidence (reviewer Q3): (1) the operator's chat is CLOUD (Claude subscription — QA7 P2/D-029), which loads NO local model and cannot cause the two-model crash, so chat is not a crash path for the acceptance run; (2) this is a SHARED chokepoint — the drainer categorize calls localInfer directly (governed at its own lane) but narrate/scheduler go through runLocal while already holding their own tickets, so a naive admit here SELF-DEADLOCKS (RESIDENT=1, a held lane admitting again is refused) unless every caller is refactored to withTicket — a cascade too broad for this CONVERGE pass and risking ~10 inference gates; (3) the correct fix is MODEL-LOAD-aware admission (count distinct loaded models, allow N concurrent requests to the SAME model) so 'chat concurrent across tabs' (agent/lane.js:12) is preserved — a request-count gate would break it. Scoped as the L11 follow-up. Residual bounded to: a user who sets the CHAT task to a LOCAL model AND chats while a background describe runs a DIFFERENT local model.
allow.src/claims/heartbeat.js: The `spawn` here is an INJECTED CALLBACK (the heartbeat's spawn(due) → startClaimDiscoveryJob), NOT node:child_process.spawn. startClaimDiscoveryJob IS governed (admits CLASS.RESIDENT lane 'claim-discovery'). No child is created in this file.
allow.src/ingest/detect-sources.js: Spawns the import-detection SWEEP CHILD (detect-sources-child.js, D-126) — a directory walker that counts file presence/dates and loads NO model weights, no GB-scale memory. It exists precisely to be KILLABLE: an iCloud-dataless dir wedged the in-process walk in an uninterruptible syscall and froze the whole REST server; the parent enforces a wall-clock deadline and SIGKILLs. Single-flight at the wrapper, keyless allowlisted env. A refused admission would reintroduce the wedge (the scan would have to run in-process); a directory listing is not resident compute, so it needs no admit() ticket.
allow.src/db/vault-copy.js: Spawns the vault-copy WORKER (src/db/vault-copy-worker.mjs), a write-capable VACUUM INTO copy of the vault in a child process (D-130) — no model weights, memory bounded by SQLite page cache, not GB-scale RAM. Same durability posture as db/snapshot-schedule.js above and DELIBERATELY NOT ticketed for the same reason: its two callers are the BOOT pre-migration snapshot (fail-closed — a refused admission would mean NO BACKUP before a destructive migration, the D-080/D-110 failure) and the pre-backfill backup (same guarantee). Contention is bounded at the source: boot runs under the cross-process init lock; the backfill copy is operator-triggered and single-flight via the job registry.
